verdict.rationale: Grok's connectors let it access a user's email, files, calendar, and business data (e.g., Salesforce) directly in chat, which supports generating insights/suggestions from personal or organizational data (grok-docs-11, grok-docs-19, grok-docs-16, grok-docs-2). However, there is no first-party or community evidence describing proactive insight-generation, summarization dashboards, or accuracy of such analysis — community feedback instead focuses on coding/agentic tool-calling weaknesses (grok-comm-6). missing for 10: explicit proactive insight/suggestion features, independent evaluation of insight quality, and documentation beyond raw data connection.
